## graphics.resetPlayerOptions

Deletes the players' graphics options of the project's game: the file &lt;project&gt;/.strata/Saves/GraphicsOptions.json that a game's options menu wrote with Graphics:\:Save while the game played here, and that every play session starts with, so that the project's Graphics Quality (the settings section Renderer.Quality, project.setSettings) applies in play again (while the file sets the preset, changes of the project's preset do not show in play; the Graphics Quality page says so). While playing, the running game also drops the players' choices from its next frame. Not undoable, like the game's saves. Returns reset: the options the players' choices had set.

Kind: `Session` · Results: `Content` · MCP toolsets: `settings` · Answers later (MayDefer): no · Waits for the asset scan: no · Registered at `StrataEditor/src/Editor/EditorGraphicsCommands.cpp:16`

No parameters.
